picks.thesis: Brighton arrive with materially stronger attacking form and have won three of the last five meetings; United have only two wins in all competitions and may rotate after the Manchester derby.
picks.invalidation: Brighton price shortens below 3.25, confirmed XI shows heavy Brighton rotation, or United field a near-full-strength attack while Brighton rest core creators.

picks.thesis: Both sides are struggling; Villa face a quick turnaround before Tottenham and are expected to rotate, reducing the normal talent-gap advantage in a knockout cup tie.
picks.invalidation: Villa confirm a strong first-choice XI, Coventry rotate heavily, or market reprices Coventry below 2.70.

note: No qualifying fixtures / no sufficiently liquid edge identified today in the other requested competitions. No forced combo because both candidates are from the same competition.
